title: Review compact score,token,notice andmeter presentation

findings.reason: 17CCN/26NLOC/depth2 is accurate. The complete function keeps three display states:absent analysis,unscored sample andnumeric percentage,using captured assessment policy/grade and optional DOM guards. The grade note occurs on either early-return or ordinary path; moving it changes update order without reducing user complexity. Existing analysis-policy checks captured grade/weight/report persistence and pipeline captures complete result UI. Keep direct branches,not a display-state framework.

15CCN/12NLOC/depth1 is accurate. Ordered exits distinguish newline,closing punctuation,quotes adjacent to punctuation/words,apostrophe fragments and opening brackets before prior quote. Two corrected-output renderers share this helper. Combining conditions or adding cached flags moves the same grammar policy into a denser expression; no duplicated implementation or observed defect. Keep explicit precedence and correction-performance/native pipeline behavior; no tokenization/calibration change.

19CCN/12NLOC:area is assigned a truthy earlier alias or final literal Overall. Thus if(area||comment) is always true and area||Overall repeats the established default. Remove only those two redundant guards;preserve row/area alias evaluation order,comment aliases,level fallback andempty-comment text. Callers cover detailed notice aliases andportfolio rendering. Add small old/new parity vectors fornull/empty/sparse/alias/level/falsey fields andgetter order;run detailed-parser/feedback-compatibility beforeafter. No generic normalizer/table required.

23CCN/59NLOC/depth3:badgeText is declared locally andassigned seven times but never read;only status is rendered. Remove that declaration/assignments. Math.min(max(0,min(150,r*100)),100) can use max(0,min(100,r*100)) for fillWidth withoutchanging number/NaN results. Keep status thresholds/order,target-off return,optional DOM guards,colors,wordcount values andhidden legacy cards. Focused native target-off/0/75%/95%/exact/105%/above vectors must preserve allvisible values;do not rewrite rubric/target calibration justtoalterCCN.
